1.description: Index finger pointed straight upwards. Thumb and remaining three fingers are tightly curled into the palm. Single hand gesture.
1.key_features: Single extended vertical index finger; all other fingers folded.
1.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'D' if fingers touch thumb, or Sign 'I' if pinky is mistaken for index.

2.description: Index and middle fingers extended straight upwards in a V shape. Ring and pinky fingers are folded down and held by the thumb. Single hand gesture.
2.key_features: Two extended upward fingers; ring and little finger closed.
2.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'V' (same shape) or Sign '5' if fingers are uncurled.

3.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended upwards and slightly separated. Little finger is folded into the palm and held down by the thumb. Single hand gesture.
3.key_features: Three upward fingers (index, middle, ring); pinky held down.
3.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'W' (spread fingers) or Sign '6' depending on regional variation.

4.description: All four fingers (index, middle, ring, pinky) held straight up vertically side-by-side. Thumb is tucked across the palm. Single hand gesture.
4.key_features: Four vertical fingers extended; thumb tucked.
4.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'B' (flat hand) if fingers are pressed together tightly.

5.description: Open hand with all five fingers and thumb fully extended, upright, and separated. Palm faces forward. Single hand gesture.
5.key_features: All 5 digits fully open and spread.
5.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '2' or Sign '4' if thumb/fingers are partially curled.

6.description: Thumb and little finger (pinky) extended outward, while index, middle, and ring fingers are curled into the palm. Single hand gesture.
6.key_features: Thumb and pinky extended out (telephone-like gesture); middle three fingers closed.
6.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'Y' or Sign 'Z' in low-light camera angles.

7.description: Index finger and thumb extended to form a right-angle or open caliper shape pointing upwards/forward. Other three fingers are closed into the palm. Single hand gesture.
7.key_features: Open L-shape or pinch gesture between index and thumb.
7.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'L' or Sign 'G'.

8.description: Middle finger tip touches the tip of the thumb to form an open circle, while index, ring, and pinky fingers remain extended upwards. Single hand gesture.
8.key_features: Middle finger and thumb touching; other 3 fingers extended.
8.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '9' or Sign 'F' where index touches thumb instead of middle.

9.description: Index finger tip touches the tip of the thumb forming a circular ring (OK sign). Middle, ring, and pinky fingers are held extended straight up. Single hand gesture.
9.key_features: Index and thumb touching to form a loop; remaining three fingers upright.
9.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'F' or Sign 'D' if finger loop angles are unclear.

A.description: Tightly closed fist with all four fingers folded against the palm. Thumb remains upright and rests against the side of the index finger. Single hand gesture.
A.key_features: Compact fist; thumb upright along the side of the index finger.
A.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'S' where thumb crosses over the front of the fingers.

B.description: Flat open hand with all four fingers held straight up, pressed tightly together side-by-side. Thumb is folded flat across the lower palm. Single hand gesture.
B.key_features: Four straight vertical fingers touching; thumb tucked over palm.
B.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '4' (spread fingers) or Sign 'Q'/'O' if fingers curve.

C.description: All fingers curved together and thumb curved below to form a clear semicircular 'C' shape facing sideways. Single hand gesture.
C.key_features: Curved arch of fingers and thumb mimicking the letter 'C'.
C.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'O' if fingertips touch thumb.

D.description: Index finger points straight up. Middle, ring, and pinky fingers curve down and touch the tip of the thumb, forming a closed circular loop below the index finger. Single hand gesture.
D.key_features: Vertical index finger with a lower circular loop formed by other fingers and thumb.
D.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '9' or Sign 'C' if index finger angle is low.

E.description: All four fingers are bent at the knuckles and curled down towards the palm. Thumb is tightly tucked underneath the fingertips. Single hand gesture.
E.key_features: Curled fingernails resting just above or touching the thumb.
E.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'S' or Sign 'O'.

F.description: Index finger and thumb touch tips to form a circular ring. The remaining three fingers (middle, ring, pinky) are held straight up, slightly spread. Single hand gesture.
F.key_features: Circular loop between index and thumb; middle, ring, pinky standing straight up.
F.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '9' (which shares this exact hand configuration in ISL/ASL).

G.description: Index finger and thumb extended horizontally parallel to each other pointing sideways like a small caliper, separated by about an inch. Other fingers folded. Single hand gesture.
G.key_features: Parallel horizontal index finger and thumb pointing sideways.
G.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'H' (which has two extended horizontal fingers).

H.description: Index and middle fingers are held straight and together, pointing horizontally sideways. Thumb is folded underneath them. Single hand gesture.
H.key_features: Two horizontal parallel fingers touching side-by-side.
H.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'G' (one horizontal finger) or Sign 'U' (vertical).

I.description: Pinky finger pointed straight up vertically. All other fingers (index, middle, ring) are folded into a closed fist with the thumb resting across them. Single hand gesture.
I.key_features: Only little finger (pinky) upright; other fingers closed in a fist.
I.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'J' (which adds a curved motion) or Sign '1'.

J.description: Hand begins in the 'I' position with pinky extended, then the pinky traces the curve of the letter 'J' downwards in the air. Single hand gesture.
J.key_features: Extended pinky with a curved hook trajectory.
J.common_confusion: May be confused with static Sign 'I'.

K.description: Index finger points straight up, middle finger angles forward, and thumb rests against the knuckle of the middle finger. Palm faces forward. Single hand gesture.
K.key_features: Index straight up, middle finger forward, thumb touching middle knuckle.
K.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'V' or Sign 'P' (which points downwards).

L.description: Index finger extended straight up vertically and thumb extended horizontally sideways at a 90-degree angle, forming the capital letter 'L'. Other three fingers closed into palm. Single hand gesture.
L.key_features: Distinct 90-degree L-shape formed by index finger and thumb.
L.common_confusion: Distinct gesture; rarely confused when viewed from front.

M.description: Three fingers (index, middle, ring) folded over the thumb, so the tip of the thumb protrudes between the ring and pinky fingers. Single hand gesture.
M.key_features: Three fingers draped over the tucked thumb.
M.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'N' (two fingers over thumb) or Sign 'A'.

N.description: Two fingers (index and middle) folded over the thumb, with the thumb tip peeking out between the middle and ring fingers. Single hand gesture.
N.key_features: Two fingers draped over the tucked thumb.
N.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'M' (three fingers) or Sign 'T' (one finger).

O.description: All four fingers curved down and touching the curved thumb tip, forming a circular 'O' shape. Single hand gesture.
O.key_features: Enclosed circular ring shape formed by all fingertips touching the thumb.
O.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'C' (open semicircle) or Sign 'E' (tight curl).

P.description: Hand is oriented downwards; index finger points straight down, middle finger points forward at an angle, and thumb touches the middle knuckle. Single hand gesture.
P.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'K' (which points upwards) or Sign 'Q'.

Q.description: Index finger and thumb extended downwards parallel to each other, like an inverted 'G' sign pointing towards the floor. Single hand gesture.
Q.key_features: Index and thumb pointing downwards like calipers.
Q.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'G' (horizontal) or Sign 'P'.

R.description: Index and middle fingers extended straight up and crossed over each other (middle finger crossing over index). Ring and pinky held down by thumb. Single hand gesture.
R.key_features: Crossed index and middle fingers (good luck gesture).
R.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'U' or Sign 'V' if crossing is not visible.

S.description: Tight fist with all four fingers curled tightly, and the thumb folded firmly across the front of the fingers. Single hand gesture.
S.key_features: Fist with thumb lying horizontally across the front knuckles.
S.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'A' (thumb alongside) or Sign 'E' (thumb under).

T.description: Fist with thumb tucked underneath the index finger, with thumb tip protruding between index and middle fingers. Single hand gesture.
T.key_features: Thumb peeking between index and middle fingers in a fist.
T.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'N' or Sign 'S'.

U.description: Index and middle fingers held straight up vertically, touching tightly together side-by-side with no gap. Ring and pinky folded and held by thumb. Single hand gesture.
U.key_features: Two vertical fingers pressed together side-by-side.
U.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'V' (separated fingers) or Sign 'H' (horizontal).

V.description: Index and middle fingers held straight up vertically and spread apart forming a clear 'V' shape (peace sign). Ring and pinky folded and held by thumb. Single hand gesture.
V.key_features: Two vertical fingers spread apart in a distinct V.
V.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'U' (fingers touching) or Sign '2'.

W.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers held straight up and spread apart to form a 'W' shape. Pinky is folded and held down by the thumb. Single hand gesture.
W.key_features: Three upright spread fingers forming a 'W'.
W.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '3' or Sign '6'.

X.description: Fist with the index finger extended and bent into a hook or crook shape (like pulling a trigger). Single hand gesture.
X.key_features: Hooked index finger; all other fingers closed into a fist.
X.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign 'D' or Sign 'E'.

Y.description: Thumb and little finger (pinky) extended far apart outwards in a 'hang loose' / shaka shape. The middle three fingers (index, middle, ring) are folded tightly against the palm. Single hand gesture.
Y.key_features: Thumb and pinky extended out to the sides; middle three fingers tucked.
Y.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '6' or Sign 'J'.

Z.description: Index finger extended straight out pointing forward and tracing the zigzag shape of the letter 'Z' in the air. Other fingers folded into a fist. Single hand gesture.
Z.key_features: Index finger tracing a zigzag 'Z' pattern in the air.
Z.common_confusion: May be confused with Sign '1' or Sign 'D' in static views.
